Logistic Regression.info: Logistic Regression is a simple, fast classification algorithm that predicts class probabilities using a linear relationship between features and the target, commonly used for binary and multiclass problems.

Ridge Classifier.info: Ridge Classifier is a linear classification algorithm that applies L2 regularization to reduce overfitting, making it stable and effective for high-dimensional and collinear data.

hyperparameters.solver: auto, svd, cholesky, lsqr, sag, saga

Perceptron.info: Perceptron is a basic linear classification algorithm that learns a decision boundary by iteratively updating weights, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Passive Aggressive Classifier.info: Passive Aggressive Classifier is a fast linear algorithm that updates its model only when it makes mistakes, making it suitable for large-scale and online binary and multiclass classification.

SGD Classifier.info: SGD Classifier is a linear model trained using stochastic gradient descent, well suited for large-scale and sparse datasets in binary and multiclass classification.

Linear SVC.info: Linear SVC is a fast linear support vector machine classifier that finds a maximum-margin decision boundary, suitable for high-dimensional binary and multiclass classification.

SVC (RBF).info: SVC with RBF kernel is a powerful classification algorithm that learns non-linear decision boundaries, effective for complex binary and multiclass classification problems.

Linear Discriminant Analysis.info: Linear Discriminant Analysis is a classification algorithm that projects data onto lower-dimensional space to maximize class separability, commonly used for binary and multiclass problems.

Quadratic Discriminant Analysis.info: Quadratic Discriminant Analysis is a classification algorithm that models each class with its own covariance matrix, enabling non-linear decision boundaries for binary and multiclass problems.

Gaussian Naive Bayes.info: Gaussian Naive Bayes is a simple probabilistic classifier based on Bayes’ theorem, assuming features follow a normal distribution, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Multinomial Naive Bayes.info: Multinomial Naive Bayes is a probabilistic classifier commonly used for discrete features such as word counts or frequencies, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Bernoulli Naive Bayes.info: Bernoulli Naive Bayes is a probabilistic classifier designed for binary or boolean features, commonly used for text and presence-absence based binary and multiclass classification.

Categorical Naive Bayes.info: Categorical Naive Bayes is a probabilistic classifier designed for categorical features, commonly used for binary and multiclass classification with discrete input variables.

Decision Tree Classifier.info: Decision Tree Classifier is a non-linear model that splits data into rules based on feature values, making it easy to interpret and suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Random Forest Classifier.info: Random Forest Classifier is an ensemble of decision trees that improves accuracy and reduces overfitting by combining predictions from multiple trees, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Extra Trees Classifier.info: Extra Trees Classifier is an ensemble of randomized decision trees that increases diversity by selecting split thresholds randomly, providing fast and robust performance for binary and multiclass classification.

Gradient Boosting Classifier.info: Gradient Boosting Classifier is an ensemble model that builds trees sequentially, where each new tree corrects errors made by previous ones, effective for binary and multiclass classification.

Histogram Gradient Boosting Classifier.info: Histogram Gradient Boosting Classifier is a fast boosting algorithm that bins continuous features into histograms, enabling efficient training on large datasets for binary and multiclass classification.

XGBoost Classifier.info: XGBoost Classifier is a high-performance gradient boosting algorithm that builds trees sequentially with advanced regularization, delivering strong results for binary and multiclass classification.

LightGBM Classifier.info: LightGBM Classifier is a fast gradient boosting algorithm that grows trees leaf-wise, making it efficient and highly accurate for large-scale binary and multiclass classification.

CatBoost Classifier.info: CatBoost Classifier is a gradient boosting algorithm that handles categorical features natively and reduces overfitting using ordered boosting, effective for binary and multiclass classification.

AdaBoost Classifier.info: AdaBoost Classifier is an ensemble algorithm that combines multiple weak learners sequentially, focusing more on misclassified samples to improve performance for binary and multiclass classification.

Bagging Classifier.info: Bagging Classifier is an ensemble method that trains multiple base models on different random subsets of data to reduce variance and improve stability for binary and multiclass classification.

Voting Classifier.info: Voting Classifier combines predictions from multiple base classifiers using majority voting or averaged probabilities to improve performance for binary and multiclass classification.

Stacking Classifier.info: Stacking Classifier is an ensemble technique that combines multiple base models by training a final meta-model on their predictions, improving performance for binary and multiclass classification.

K-Nearest Neighbors.info: K-Nearest Neighbors is a simple instance-based classifier that predicts labels based on the majority class of the nearest data points, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Radius Neighbors Classifier.info: Radius Neighbors Classifier predicts labels based on all training samples within a fixed radius, making it useful for density-based binary and multiclass classification.

Nearest Centroid.info: Nearest Centroid is a simple classification algorithm that assigns classes based on the closest class centroid, offering fast and interpretable binary and multiclass classification.

Multi-layer Perceptron.info: Multi-layer Perceptron is a feedforward neural network that learns complex non-linear relationships through hidden layers, suitable for binary and multiclass classification.

Label Propagation.info: Label Propagation is a semi-supervised learning algorithm that spreads labels through a similarity graph, allowing learning from a small amount of labeled data for classification.

Label Spreading.info: Label Spreading is a semi-supervised learning algorithm that propagates labels across a similarity graph while controlling the influence of initial labels, suitable for classification with limited labeled data.

One-vs-Rest Classifier.info: One-vs-Rest Classifier is a strategy that trains one binary classifier per class, enabling binary classifiers to handle multiclass classification problems.

One-vs-One Classifier.info: One-vs-One Classifier is a multiclass strategy that trains a binary classifier for every pair of classes, enabling complex decision boundaries for multiclass classification.

Output Code Classifier.info: Output Code Classifier is a multiclass strategy that represents classes using binary codewords, improving robustness and enabling binary classifiers to solve multiclass problems.

Calibrated Classifier CV.info: Calibrated Classifier CV improves the reliability of predicted probabilities by applying probability calibration methods on an existing classifier using cross-validation.

Balanced Random Forest.info: Balanced Random Forest is an ensemble method designed for imbalanced datasets that balances classes through random under-sampling while training multiple decision trees.

Balanced Bagging Classifier.info: Balanced Bagging Classifier is an ensemble method for imbalanced datasets that combines bagging with random under-sampling to improve performance on minority classes.

Easy Ensemble Classifier.info: Easy Ensemble Classifier is an ensemble method for imbalanced datasets that trains multiple classifiers on different balanced subsets created via random under-sampling.

RUSBoost Classifier.info: RUSBoost Classifier combines random under-sampling with boosting to improve classification performance on highly imbalanced datasets.

SAMME Classifier.info: SAMME Classifier is a multiclass boosting algorithm that combines multiple weak learners to improve classification accuracy by focusing on misclassified samples.
